question: Will the Senate pass the CLARITY Act before summer recess?

model.prompt_context: Resolves YES if the United States Senate holds and passes a floor vote on the CLARITY Act (Digital Asset Market Clarity Act, or its Senate companion/amended version) between 00:00 UTC August 4, 2026 and 03:59 UTC August 10, 2026 (11:59 PM EDT August 9, 2026), per the official legislative record at congress.gov. Committee votes, procedural motions, and House-only action do not count; only final Senate passage of the bill itself resolves YES. No qualifying Senate passage by the deadline resolves NO.
